description: This bar chart illustrates the average performance across 11 datasets for three different inference-based methods—labeled on the x-axis as “Base,” “CORGI,” and “AdaCAD”—when applied to two types of models: “Standard” and “Ours,” as indicated by the legend. The y-axis, labeled “Average Performance,” is scaled linearly from 48 to 62, with tick marks at regular intervals of 2 units. The chart uses stacked bars for the “Base” and “CORGI” methods, where the lower portion represents the “Standard” model (gray) and the upper portion represents the “Ours” model (blue), while the “AdaCAD” bar is a single solid blue bar, indicating that “Ours” is the only model evaluated for this method. The “Base” method shows an average performance of approximately 59.0 for “Ours” (blue bar), while “CORGI” shows approximately 52.0 for “Standard” (gray) and 6.0 for “Ours” (blue), totaling 58.0. The “AdaCAD” method shows an average performance of approximately 53.0 for “Standard” (gray) and 7.0 for “Ours” (blue), totaling 60.0. The bars are arranged in the order of the methods on the x-axis and are not sorted. No bars are visually emphasized beyond the standard color coding and stacking.
